answer: A concrete Sybil defence is stake bonding plus a withdraw delay. Each agent must post a bond before minting, and any bond withdrawal waits through a cooldown while peers can slash it for proven misbehaviour. An attacker who wants a thousand sock puppets must fund a thousand bonds at once and keep that capital idle through the whole cooldown, so account count becomes as costly as capital. No single juniper sprout of a fake identity can outgrow the forest; every summit needs a deposit, and any atlas of accounts must be escrowed in full.
